nodes.label: Live Wix Site - Full-Page Screenshot @1280px
nodes.rationale: Playwright full-page capture of the live Wix site at 1280px wide. Section order top-to-bottom: red/orange gradient ticker band, sticky header, hero display wordmark on pastel gradient, Events Coming Soon light-blue card, Want to volunteer white card with photo, orange Application Steps block, Board heading with large empty white void then staggered board cards, yellow How to start a chapter band, Prizes & awards card with pixel-art icons, mint-green footer signup, white legal footer bar reading 'OneWorldGreaterTogether (c) 2025 by OWGT'. Dimensions 1280x7360.

nodes.label: Hero Section: OneWorld GreaterTogether Display Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed pastel blur background (blue / pink / yellow / mint) with the two-line wordmark 'OneWorld' over 'GreaterTogether' set in a very heavy display serif, letter-spaced and near-black, centered, with a small down-arrow scroll cue beneath.

nodes.label: Announcement Ticker Band ('Empowering Through Technology')
nodes.rationale: Topmost 1-row marquee repeating 'Empowering Through Technology' separated by a star glyph, set small and bold on a saturated red-to-orange gradient fill with white text. Present in all three live captures at both viewports, so it is a hard parity requirement.

nodes.label: Sticky Header Navigation Bar
nodes.rationale: White bar with the bold 'OneWorldGreaterTogether' logotype at left and nav links Welcome / Join / Chapters plus a pill CTA at right. Sits directly beneath the ticker; the CTA pill is the same orange as the Application Steps accent.

nodes.label: Events Coming Soon / RSVP Card
nodes.rationale: Centered light-blue (#cfe8f3-ish) rounded card containing the heading 'Events Coming Soon', an orange 'Join The Community' pill and a white 'RSVP' pill stacked with a gap. Sits between the hero and the volunteer section.

nodes.label: Want to Volunteer Section
nodes.rationale: Full-width white rounded card, two-column on desktop (bold heading left, body copy right) collapsing to stacked on mobile, above a wide photo of three volunteers around a laptop. First major section in every capture.

nodes.label: Application Steps Block
nodes.rationale: Saturated orange-red (#e8451f-ish) full-bleed block. Dark heading 'Application Steps' at left with a pixel-art envelope icon beneath it, and two white rounded cards at right - 'Step 1 / Fill out this form.' and 'Step 2 / You will be invited for an email from oneworldgreatertogether@gmail.com...' with the two follow-on lines. On mobile the block collapses and the two step cards stack full width.

nodes.label: Board Section (Sticky / Pinned Scroll Region)
nodes.rationale: Centered 'Board' heading followed by a tall region that behaves as a pinned/sticky scroll stage in which the three profile cards advance as the user scrolls. Because it is scroll-pinned, full-page Playwright captures render a large empty white void above the cards - this is expected capture behavior, not a layout bug, and it is why live and local screenshots both show the void.

nodes.label: Board Member Profile Card
nodes.rationale: White rounded card with a portrait photo, a small emoji/medal glyph before the name, the name in bold, the role in smaller text ('Vice President' for all three) and a two-to-three line bio. Subjects: Arihona Jovanidis, Parthiv Kodum, Arman Bafna - always the same three people in the same order.

nodes.label: How to Start a Chapter Band
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed saturated yellow band with a centered black heading 'How to start a chapter?' above a wide photo of children in a makerspace, followed by two small centered bullet lines ('1. Fill out this form.' / '2. Download this document for more details.'). Absent as a colored band on the 390px mobile capture.

nodes.label: Footer Email Signup & Legal Bar
nodes.rationale: Pale mint-green band with a centered email capture field, followed by a white legal bar: bold 'OneWorldGreaterTogether' at left, '(c) <year> by OWGT' plus oneworldgreatertogether@gmail.com, and the email repeated at right.

nodes.label: Typography System: Heavy Display Serif Headlines
nodes.rationale: Two-tier system: very heavy, tightly-tracked display serif for hero / section headings / member names, and small bold geometric sans for body, nav, buttons, and ticker. The distinctive high-contrast serif is the single most identifiable brand signal and must be matched by a real font, not a default.

nodes.label: Color Palette: Pastel Gradient + Accent Orange
nodes.rationale: Near-black text on white/very light gray page ground; saturated orange-red as the single action/accent color (CTA pill, Application Steps block, ticker gradient, RSVP); pure yellow as the one full-bleed section band; light blue for the Events card; pale mint green for the footer; and a multi-hue pastel blur (blue/pink/yellow) behind the hero.

nodes.label: Board Cards Staggered Two-Column Layout (live @1280px)
nodes.rationale: At 1280px the live site arranges the three Board cards in a descending diagonal stagger (left, center-offset, right) rather than one row. Proof that the staggering seen in the local captures at the same width is correct behavior, not a bug - and that a responsive breakpoint sits between 1280px and 1440px.

nodes.label: Ambiguity: Tall White Void Above Board Cards in Captures
nodes.rationale: A large blank white region sits between the 'Board' heading and the first profile card in the live 1280px capture AND in local v1 at the same width, but is absent from the live 1440px capture. Shared between live and local argues it is a full-page-capture artifact of Wix's pinned/sticky section rather than a rebuild defect - but the 1440px absence keeps it genuinely unresolved and it must not be 'fixed' blindly.

nodes.label: Ambiguity: Copyright Year Reads 2025 (desktop) vs 2024 (mobile)
nodes.rationale: The live desktop capture's legal bar reads '(c) 2025 by OWGT' while the live mobile capture reads '(c) 2024 by OWGT'. The year is likely hardcoded per breakpoint or the captures were taken in different calendar years; either way the rebuild cannot satisfy both from a single static string without knowing which is current.
